class LPproperties:
    """LP property class."""

    __m = None
    __id = None
    __name = None

    @property
    def model(self):
        return self.__m

    @model.setter
    def model(self, model):
        self.__m = model

    @property
    def id(self):
        return self.__pid

    @id.setter
    def id(self, pid):
        self.__pid = pid

    @property
    def name(self):
        return self.__name

    @name.setter
    def name(self, name):
        self.__name = name
